lg.ch.r.country: Sales in the country open after signing.
lg.ch.r.decrease: Effective right after signatures; old prices apply until then.
lg.ch.r.increase: Notice ≥ 90 days: effective {d}; unsigned → country orders blocked.
lg.ch.title: Released changes
lg.chg.pending: A change-of-details request is waiting for OTA review.
lg.chg.reqD: Signed documents are not reissued. After OTA checks the change you’ll sign a change-of-details notice.
lg.chg.title: New versions & changes
lg.chg.toSign: OTA approved the change of details — sign notice {n}.
lg.cls.r.A.m: New keys and tokens blocked for the country
lg.cls.r.A.w: Prices and commercial terms (new Order Form version); rights and obligations in 01, 03, 05A, 06, 09
lg.cls.r.Adown.w: New Order Form version in the partner’s favour
lg.cls.r.Anew.m: Sales in the country don’t open
lg.cls.r.B.w: Clarifications of 04, sub-processors (06), editorial edits, templates 10–14
lg.cls.title: Change classes (MPA clause 16.5)
lg.cmt.d: Field “{f}”. You can’t mark it “not applicable” yourself — leave a note and OTA will decide.
lg.cmt.title: Don’t have this data
lg.dec.d: Don’t agree with the change? Leave a comment — it goes to the OTA manager.
lg.dec.note: The partner declined this change: “{c}” ({n}). The blocking rule is unchanged.
lg.dec.rule: Declining doesn’t change the blocking rule: after the effective date new orders for the country are blocked until it’s signed.
lg.dec.title: Class A change declined
lg.det.how: The portal compares each country price list with the version in its Order Form.
lg.det.none: All Order Forms match the price lists in force.
lg.det.title: Price-list changes found
lg.dev.empty: Add models or fill from the catalog
lg.df.sum: Clauses changed: {n}. The new version takes effect: {e}.
lg.df.title: Compare versions
lg.docs.admin: OTA mode: generate, issue and sign for OTA. Yellow-highlighted drafts are visible to OTA only.
lg.docs.sub: The CONNECT FOR BRANDS package: generated from the questionnaire, e-signed by both parties, versioned when terms change.
lg.docs.title: Documents
lg.dv.draftOta: OTA draft: partner data is highlighted in yellow. The final PDF has no highlighting.
lg.dv.draftP: Draft — not issued for signature yet.
lg.dv.effA: Takes effect on {d}. If not signed by then, new key and token orders for {c} will be blocked.
lg.dv.effB: Takes effect automatically on {d}. Nothing is blocked.
lg.dv.integBad: Hash mismatch — the document was changed
lg.dv.missT: Missing data: {n}. The document can’t be issued for signature.
lg.dv.superseded: This version was superseded by {n}. It stays available for download.
lg.e.iban: Check the IBAN: 2 country letters, 2 digits, then the account number
lg.e.issueD: Required data or a translation is missing. Fill in the fields or mark them “not applicable”, then try again.
lg.e.prep: OTA is preparing this document — it will appear here when ready.
lg.e.stopD: Paragraphs without a {l} translation: {ids}. Add the translation to the template and try again.
lg.f.P_TM_OWNER_IS_PARTNER: Does your company own the marks?
lg.form.otaRo: OTA mode: the partner fills in the questionnaire. “Not applicable” flags, the 05A/05B choice and country data are on the Partner review page.
lg.form.sub: Every field goes into the package documents. If you don’t have something, leave a note — OTA decides whether the field is not applicable.
lg.form.title: Partner questionnaire
lg.h.DEVICES: The partner fills in, OTA approves. Only approved models go into Annex 1.
lg.h.P_BANK_INTERMEDIARY: No intermediary bank? Leave a note for OTA
lg.h.P_FORM_EN: E.g. a private limited company incorporated in England and Wales
lg.h.P_TM_LIST: Mark, registration no. and office, countries, Nice classes
lg.kep.d: Need a qualified e-signature (KEP) for your accounting? Download the PDF, sign it and add the file as an additional copy.
lg.kyc.authority.d: Position or power of attorney verified
lg.kyc.registry.d: Company exists; number and address match the questionnaire
lg.kyc.sanctions.d: Company, UBOs, signatory — OFAC, EU, UK, UN
lg.kyc.territories.d: No sales in Russia, Belarus or occupied territories
lg.lang2.d: Documents are always in English; the second column is the language you choose. Only languages with a full approved translation of every template are available.
lg.locked.d: The package has been issued — these details change through OTA (a new document version or a change-of-details notice).
lg.na.d: Field {f} will not appear in any document.
lg.na.title: Mark “not applicable”
lg.ota.onlyD: Turn on OTA mode in the sidebar.
lg.otp.bad: Wrong code. Check the e-mail and try again.
lg.otp.d: We sent a 6-digit code to {e}. One signature for {n} documents.
lg.otp.legal: A portal signature confirmed by a one-time code, with the audit trail, is a valid electronic signature (MPA clause 2.5).
lg.otp.title: Confirm signature
lg.pkg.draftNote: Drafts: numbers are assigned and won’t change when you regenerate. Partner data is highlighted in yellow.
lg.pkg.emptyD.form: The package is generated from your questionnaire. Fill it in and submit it to OTA.
lg.pkg.emptyD.ready: Review complete — OTA is generating the documents.
lg.pkg.emptyD.review: OTA checks the data, assigns the partner code and sets prices. Then the package is generated.
lg.pkg.signedNote: Signed by both parties. Key and token orders are open.
lg.pkg.title: Partner package
lg.print.hint: A4, two columns. In the print dialog choose “Save as PDF”.
lg.pub.d: Published on the partner’s domain in one language (the user’s), without header or document number. Version number: OTA-EUT-CC-lang-vX.Y.
lg.pub.exists: This version is already published — release a new one
lg.pub.title: Public documents 07 / 08
lg.rem.copy: E-mail to the partner signatory, copy to the OTA manager.
lg.rem.title: Reminders
lg.rv.adminNote: OTA team actions (OTA Admin / OTA Legal). The partner only sees the result.
lg.rv.brandD: If the partner owns the marks — licence 05A; if another company does — brand owner letter 05B (signed scan).
lg.rv.brandNone: Choose one — the package can’t be generated without it.
lg.rv.codeBad.reserved: This code is reserved (OTA, INV, TST)
lg.rv.codeBad.taken: Another partner already uses this code
lg.rv.codeD: 3 Latin letters, unique forever; OTA, INV, TST are reserved. The code is part of every document number.
lg.rv.naRule: Only OTA sets “not applicable”. Such a field never appears in any document: the table row or the conditional fragment is removed entirely.
lg.rv.next: Review complete. Generate the document package.
lg.rv.otaD: Shared by all partners. An empty field = “not applicable” and is never printed.
lg.rv.sub: {n}: questionnaire, KYC, code, 05A/05B, prices and countries
lg.rv.title: Partner review
lg.sg.agree: I have read and am authorised to sign on behalf of {p}
lg.sg.agreeAck: I have read the new version on behalf of {p}
